title: Getting started
summary: Choose React or Preact, register your routes, and mount the provider.

sections.title: Install
sections.body: Install the router and the framework you use. Framework peers are optional; choosing React does not install Preact.
sections.code:
pnpm add @kasperrt/smolter react react-dom
# Or: pnpm add @kasperrt/smolter preact

sections.title: Register a route
sections.body: Keep the data handler beside the page. defineRoute retains its handler types. Manual routes use the first matching pattern, so put static paths before dynamic paths.

sections.title: Render
sections.body: Create the router outside render. The provider starts its initial load and attaches history listeners. Routes renders the matching module.

sections.title: Try the demo
sections.body: Counter shows actions and revalidation. Tasks shows POST creation and independent fetcher reads. A task detail route uses :id with PATCH and DELETE. Search uses a GET form and shareable query parameters. The URL bar is driven by useLocation.
